news.headline: Ryland provided all of the offense for Arizona in Week 10, making multiple field goals in a contest for the fourth time
news.detail: Ryland provided all of the offense for Arizona in Week 10, making multiple field goals in a contest for the fourth time in the last five weeks. The kicker has rebounded well in 2026 after a challenging 2025 campaign, converting 22 of 24 field-goal tries over 10 contests so far this season.
